name: The Admiral's Orders
summary: On Durotar’s coast, the Admiral’s Orders carry word of a threat to the young Horde. Sealed by the late Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, they show that the Kul Tiran garrison is organized and entrenched. Gar'Thok in Razor Hill needs to know what they contain.

sections.title: A Sealed Legacy
sections.body: On the upper floors of Tiragarde Keep, a heavy chest holds an aged envelope under Lieutenant Benedict’s watch. Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore sealed it with his crest. Its parchment gives naval commands from Kul Tiras’s bloody invasion of Durotar. Though the Grand Admiral fell at Theramore, his officers still hold their fortifications and cling to their mission against the Horde settlement.

sections.title: Alarm in Razor Hill
sections.body: Gar'Thok commands Razor Hill’s local defense force. When you bring him the recovered papers, they confirm that the Kul Tiran soldiers on the eastern shore are an established force awaiting reinforcements. They are no mere castaways. Gar'Thok sees that Durotar’s survival depends on breaking Tiragarde’s command structure.

faq.q: Where are the Admiral's Orders found?
faq.answer: The orders lie in an aged envelope inside a locked chest on Tiragarde Keep’s third floor. Lieutenant Benedict guards the second floor and carries the key.

Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore ruled Kul Tiras and commanded the Alliance naval fleet during the Second War. He refused to believe orcs could live in peace, so he sailed to Kalimdor to wage a war of extermination against Durotar. He died at Theramore.

faq.q: Why are Kul Tiran soldiers still in Tiragarde Keep?
faq.answer: Daelin Proudmoore built fortified coastal footholds such as Tiragarde Keep during his invasion of Durotar. After his defeat, surviving officers and marines under Lieutenant Benedict held their posts and continued his campaign against the Horde.

faq.q: Why is Gar'Thok so concerned about these orders?
faq.answer: Gar'Thok commands Razor Hill and guards central Durotar. The orders show that Tiragarde Keep is an active, deliberate military threat to the orcish homeland, not a band of stranded survivors.

faq.q: Who holds the key to the Admiral's chest?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Benedict, the Kul Tiran officer commanding on Tiragarde Keep’s second floor, carries the key to the strongbox with the aged envelope.

faq.q: What happens after giving the orders to Gar'Thok?
faq.answer: Gar'Thok sees that Proudmoore’s plans were made before his death, and more of his men may land on Durotar’s shores. He sends the orders to Orgrimmar at once, so the Warchief’s council can be warned.

angles.text: Proudmoore’s orders show that the Alliance presence on Durotar’s shores was an organized campaign of extermination. The Horde must defend its new home with care.
For orcs building a future in Durotar, these papers recall Daelin Proudmoore’s hatred and the remnants who still seek their destruction.
